tui.chrome.remote_park.approval_title.role: Title line of a notification/card for a session parked on ANOTHER device that needs an approval
tui.chrome.remote_park.approval_title.tone: plain state sentence, no full stop
tui.chrome.remote_park.approval_title.note: EN-only context sidecar. Notification-centre title and inbox row title. {device} is the other device's human name (a proper name: keep verbatim, never translate).

tui.chrome.remote_park.ask_title.role: Title line of a notification/card for a session parked on ANOTHER device that asks a question
tui.chrome.remote_park.ask_title.tone: plain state sentence, no full stop
tui.chrome.remote_park.ask_title.note: EN-only context sidecar. Notification-centre title and inbox row title. {device} is the other device's human name (a proper name: keep verbatim, never translate).

tui.chrome.remote_park.approval_lead.role: First sentence of the body for a remote approval park, read by someone elsewhere
tui.chrome.remote_park.approval_lead.note: EN-only context sidecar. The one gesture available from this machine is DENY. Followed (after a space) by `approval_remainder`; keep it self-contained. No ICU arguments.

tui.chrome.remote_park.approval_attached.role: Replacement first sentence when the reader is already attached to the session but the gate card is not yet on screen
tui.chrome.remote_park.approval_attached.note: EN-only context sidecar. Followed (after a space) by `approval_remainder`. No ICU arguments.

tui.chrome.remote_park.approval_remainde.role: Rest of the body for a remote approval park: where allowing happens and what to do if it cannot
tui.chrome.remote_park.approval_remainde.tone: plain, instructive, product words (no terminal commands)
tui.chrome.remote_park.approval_remainde.note: EN-only context sidecar. `Touch ID` is Apple's name (verbatim). `Local Operator` is the product name. {device} is the other device's human name (a proper name: keep verbatim, never translate).

tui.chrome.remote_park.approval_remedy.role: Second paragraph of the inbox row body: the exact one-time remedy, with commands
tui.chrome.remote_park.approval_remedy.note: EN-only context sidecar. The two `lop …` commands and `anchor.json` are literal and must stay verbatim (they are typed by the reader). `Touch ID` is Apple's name. {device} is the other device's human name (a proper name: keep verbatim, never translate).

tui.chrome.remote_park.ask_body.role: Body for a remote ask park
tui.chrome.remote_park.ask_body.note: EN-only context sidecar. No ICU arguments.

tui.chrome.remote_park.approval_banner.role: OS banner BODY for a remote approval park
tui.chrome.remote_park.approval_banner.note: EN-only context sidecar. macOS Notification Centre shows about 110 characters on one line; keep close to the English length. {device} is the other device's human name (a proper name: keep verbatim, never translate).

tui.chrome.remote_park.ask_banner.role: OS banner BODY for a remote ask park
tui.chrome.remote_park.ask_banner.note: EN-only context sidecar. About 110 characters on one line. {device} is the other device's human name (a proper name: keep verbatim, never translate).

tui.chrome.remote_park.approval_hint_pho.role: Longest rung of the gate card's hint row: where allow happens, what works here
tui.chrome.remote_park.approval_hint_pho.note: EN-only context sidecar. The card sheds WHOLE rungs by width, longest first; the four approval rungs must keep this order of detail. {device} is the other device's human name (a proper name: keep verbatim, never translate).

tui.chrome.remote_park.approval_hint_tou.role: Second rung of the gate card's hint row
tui.chrome.remote_park.approval_hint_tou.note: EN-only context sidecar. Shorter than the phone rung. {device} is the other device's human name (a proper name: keep verbatim, never translate).

tui.chrome.remote_park.approval_hint_the.role: Third rung of the gate card's hint row
tui.chrome.remote_park.approval_hint_the.note: EN-only context sidecar. Shorter than the Touch ID rung. {device} is the other device's human name (a proper name: keep verbatim, never translate).

tui.chrome.remote_park.approval_hint_flo.role: Floor rung of the approval card's hint row
tui.chrome.remote_park.approval_hint_flo.note: EN-only context sidecar. The locality fact alone; implies nothing about allowing from here. {device} is the other device's human name (a proper name: keep verbatim, never translate).

tui.chrome.remote_park.ask_hint_answer.role: Longest rung of the ask card's hint row
tui.chrome.remote_park.ask_hint_answer.note: EN-only context sidecar. Asks can be answered from here; there is no deny on this card. {device} is the other device's human name (a proper name: keep verbatim, never translate).

tui.chrome.remote_park.ask_hint_floor.role: Floor rung of the ask card's hint row
tui.chrome.remote_park.ask_hint_floor.note: EN-only context sidecar. The locality fact alone. {device} is the other device's human name (a proper name: keep verbatim, never translate).
